csv_project_name: AE for Barrett Memorial Library Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Barrett Memorial Library, in partnership with the Village of Williams Bay, is seeking proposals from qualified Architecture and Engineering A/E firms to provide professional design services for a comprehensive library improvement project. The project will focus on both interior and exterior renovations to the Barrett Memorial Library. The selected consultant will provide architectural, landscape, interior design, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and telecommunications engineering services. Design services will include conceptual planning, design development, construction documents, permitting, bidding assistance, and construction administration.
